arStrings.szText: To gain access to {c_highlight}chaos{/c}-infected Nightmare Dungeons, look for Nightmare Dungeon Sigils with the {c_highlight}Chaos Rift{/c} affix in Helltides.
Slay {c_highlight}chaos{/c}-infected demons and close {c_highlight}Chaos Rifts{/c} to earn {c_highlight}Viz-Jaq'taar Veneration{/c}.

Explore {c_highlight}chaos{/c}-infected Nightmare Dungeons to find {c_highlight}Fleeting Compasses{/c} that grant access to {c_highlight}Fleeting Hordes{/c} – a streamlined pre-Torment version of Infernal Hordes.
{c_highlight}Chaos Rifts{/c} can be found in Helltides and chaos-infected Nightmare Dungeons.
